gotchas: No guest checkout: Proceed to Buy from the cart lands on the sign-in page (identifier first at #ap_email_login, then #ap_password; input#continue does not exist on the identifier step, press Enter on the field instead).
A new device gets a one-time code after the password (input[name*='otp']); detect_challenge reports it and request_challenge_handoff reaches the owner. snapshot_page is closed from then on.

The new-card form lives inside iframe.apx-secure-iframe and mounts only after clicking the 'Credit or debit card' row and then the add-card link inside it; pass the iframe as `frame` to every card field. Expiry is two <select>s whose option values are the bare month number (value "2" for February) and the four-digit year.

The security code is on the same form as the number, so number and code go back to back. On a deployment with live CVV entry the code leg waits for the owner and fails with a timeout if they do not enter it; the number is already in the form by then, so do not refill it.

Every order-summary row reuses span[data-shimmer-target="ordertotals-amount"]; the Order Total is the last row, reachable as li:last-child .order-summary-line-definition (an attribute-value selector is refused by declare_page_hint).
Search results open the product in a new tab: wait_for_popup after clicking the title link.
Sign-in and checkout raised no bot wall from the staging proxy's egress on 2026-09-30, which Amazon geolocated to an Indian pincode.
notes: Driven through the staging proxy on 2026-09-30 with a signed-in account that already had a delivery address. Name, expiry and card number filled inside the secure iframe; the CVV leg was refused by the proxy's live-CVV timeout, not by the page, and the add-card form was left unsubmitted. No order was placed.

overrides.addCardLink: :text-matches("add a new credit or debit card|enter card details","i") >> visible=true
